components.css: .ds-field-label{display:grid;gap:7px;font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:550;line-height:1.5;color:#3f5042}.ds-field{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:550;line-height:1.5;width:100%;min-height:37px;padding:9px 11px;border:1px solid #cbd6c9;border-radius:6px;background:var(--paper,#fffefa);color:var(--ink,#20332e);caret-color:var(--accent,#28644e)}.ds-field:focus{border-color:#729b7d}.ds-field:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#7aab8e);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: App Navigation
components.description: Deep navigation with pale-leaf active destination.
components.html: 知识库文档写作
components.css: .ds-nav{display:grid;gap:7px;background:var(--sidebar,#172e28);padding:16px;font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif}.ds-nav a{display:flex;align-items:center;padding:11px 12px;border-radius:7px;color:#bccdbf;text-decoration:none;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;transition:background .15s,color .15s}.ds-nav a:hover{background:#263f34;color:#f0f4e6}.ds-nav a.ds-nav-active{background:#dce8ca;color:#203d2b}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#7aab8e);outline-offset:3px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav a{transition:none}}

components.name: Reading Panel
components.description: Flat paper container with a rule-separated heading and source prose.
components.html:
资料预览

从资料出发，写出有依据的内容。 原文和取材依据保留在一起。
components.css: .ds-panel{background:var(--paper,#fffefa);border:1px solid var(--line,#e0e5dc);border-radius:9px;overflow:hidden;font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#20332e)}.ds-panel header{padding:12px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#e0e5dc);font-size:10px;color:#68765d}.ds-panel p{margin:0;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;padding:23px 22px;font-size:13px;line-height:2.15;color:#536b43}

narrative.overview:
Quill places warm working paper beside a deep green navigation rail. The mood is calm, literate and compact: muted olive metadata supports deep ink titles, while green identifies actions and the current working context. The small serif wordmark provides the literary cue; Chinese working text uses the platform sans stack.

This system records the approved reading-workbench replacement as implemented in the shared shell and knowledge surface. It is extracted from App.vue, workbench.css and knowledge.css, including their final cascade overrides. Knowledge inspection is its first expression; collection widths and preview behavior below describe that expression rather than a mandatory composition for every page. Inherited template/create screens retain scoped treatments and have not all been redesigned.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper surfaces and a deep ink-green app rail.
Compact, rule-separated information with restrained rounded containers.
Chinese sans reading text, a serif wordmark and Lucide line icons.
Selected-source context and keyboard focus remain visibly distinct.

rules.name: The Quiet Paper Rule
rules.body: Use green for action and selection, and warm paper for sustained reading. Metadata uses the final olive-text treatment rather than the older pale olive declarations earlier in the stylesheet.

rules.name: The Working Text Rule
rules.body: Keep the serif face in the wordmark. Use the platform sans stack for Chinese headings, controls and source text; preserve the reading role when density increases.

rules.name: The Flat Workbench Rule
rules.body: Keep ordinary library and preview surfaces flat with fine borders. Reserve soft shadows for the connection popover and the intermediate-width floating preview.

dos: Do use the shared paper, ground, ink and green action roles when adding a surface.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, the reduced-motion override and the source preview’s focus restoration.
Do use line icons with visible labels or accessible names; preserve readable Chinese source titles and wrapping.
Do keep the original text and source metadata available beside or in place of the resource list as space permits.
donts: Don’t introduce a new display face for working text; the serif wordmark already supplies the typographic contrast.
Don’t use the inherited template pages’ emoji icons or blue glow shadows as patterns for new workbench components.
Don’t add shadows to every container; use border and surface tone for resting structure.
Don’t present reading segments, vector readiness, counts or answers as decoration; their labels and states must follow actual data.
